text:
I feel a vague childish tenderness

when in the coolness of the damp orchards

the sweet cicadas of April weep

their unsayable uncertain prayers.


Trembling cries that the subtle breeze

carries on its wings, like dead leaves

toward the soft plains, open

beneath skies of rose and indigo...


Oh, singers of the laughing hut,

who with their tenderness lull the river

as the coyol flower half-opens...


And in their songs they sigh and weep

among the clear groves gilded by

the melancholy sunsets...

translation.title: As the Coyol Flower Half-Opens
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the cicadas as singers of the hut and the coyol flower's half-opening.
